scope: previous capacity business chains, grouped mixed paths; no claim that grouped sub-paths are tested at their standalone peak rate

criteria.capacity: original full-operation P95 100ms/P99 250ms, success >=99.5%, drop <=0.1%; original cold-login exception
criteria.stability: report 60s/300s windows, early/middle/late mature-window latency, throughput/drop/inflight; distinguish isolated excursions from persistent growth; never infer plateau from final drain alone
criteria.backlog: count and age of unexported committed audit records during load, recovery while arrival continues, final DB/receiver/signed checkpoint reconciliation
criteria.storage: live/retained/eligible counts and oldest due age, real maintenance cycles, target cohort zero, physical high-water and TTL key populations separately
criteria.limits: finite windows; legal retention longer than the run is expected growth, not proven plateau; unexercised product protocols are not asserted covered
